scope: Independent macro-structure and painting-consistency review only; internal seams deliberately not re-reviewed.
method: Viewed current 4096 candidate displayed at 1600px overview, 1254px Mid-Autumn shared structure, 1254px authoritative day geometry, and read their provenance. Also reused native row3 visual review from this subtask.

coordinateBasis.note: Compare mapped image-space positions, not raw x/y across files of differing sizes. This review does not certify day/festival runtime navigation coordinates.

macroChecks.result: Preserved. Stool silhouette and standing footprint, planter curve and tree base occupy their expected places. No new road obstruction observed.
Preserved open passage. Curving paving bands and major grout junctions continue from upper center around lanterns toward stair landing; no new median or missing route observed.
Both poles and four cylindrical hanging lanterns retained. Post bases remain in planted edge pockets; no observed displacement into open route.
Two rounded cap posts and horizontal rail opening pattern retained, including junction with stair railing; no missing rail span apparent at macro scale.
Wide descending staircase, parallel risers, landing and both side rails retain shared reference extent and orientation. No added step, missing stair span or blocked stair mouth apparent.
Lower-left roof footprint, lower shrub bed, right curved planter and upper planter remain within their reference silhouettes.
Right planter shadow still falls leftward over the same pavement area near stair top; warm/cool appearance changed as intended.

specificFindings.location: broad road surfaces, especially upper-middle and central paving
specificFindings.finding: Native redraw uses more visible polygonal brush planes than the 1254 shared reference, while stone contours remain clean and rounded. This is visible material variation, not a structural failure.
specificFindings.recommendation: Do not sharpen or add micro-grain; retain the current clean broad-surface treatment when extending adjacent tiles.

specificFindings.location: lantern poles, foreground roofs, lower planting
specificFindings.finding: Wood grain and dark outline strength vary slightly between patches; overall warm wood, rounded blue stone, plump jade leaves and lantern treatment remain one coherent chibi painting style in the assembled overview.
specificFindings.recommendation: No independent macro-level redraw identified; any local seam or luminance adjustment remains part of parent QA.

specificFindings.finding: The day reference and festival reference visually share structure, but no runtime navigation overlay or measured landmark registration was inspected. This review cannot prove pixel-exact or walkability-equivalent alignment.
specificFindings.recommendation: Keep navigationVerified/clientVerified false until the shared transform and client/nav check are independently completed.

conclusion: No macro structural omission or newly blocked route found in the inspected candidate. Geometry appears consistent with the shared day-to-festival structure after layout-canvas mapping. No new redraw request from this review.
exclusions: six internal seam strips already reviewed by root
